# Princess Erroria (Alula)

Princess Erroria is the pale-yellow, purple-maned pegasus filly who accidentally appeared with **both a horn and wings** in Twilight's imagined magic kindergarten. That animation slip made her a fandom “princess,” not an actual ruler in *Friendship is Magic*. She also turns up as a Rainbow Dash superfan. Her appearance varies between episodes: cobalt-blue eyes, a lavender mane with a lighter streak, and occasionally a flower, feather, horseshoe, or no cutie mark. The fan-maintained [character and appearance guide](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Princess_Erroria) documents her changing background designs.

**Names and identity.** **Alula** was an earlier fan placeholder; **Princess Animatia Erroria**, shortened to **Princess Erroria**, arose from a 2013 /mlp/ naming discussion about the *Lesson Zero* animation mistake. These are **fandom names**, not verified in-show or official royal titles. The horn-and-wings depiction was an error, not a confirmed transformation or secret royal identity ([naming history](https://mlpfanart.fandom.com/wiki/Princess_Erroria)).

**Speaking status.** Mainly a silent background filly, she has identifiable dialogue in **“Fame and Misfortune” (S7E14)**. As an overenthusiastic “Team Dash” fan, she says she removed Twilight's lessons from the friendship journal; the [episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Fame_and_Misfortune) records her lines. The character guide attributes her English voice to **Andrea Libman**, though this character-specific credit is fan-documented rather than an individually named on-screen credit.

## Important moments

- **The accidental alicorn — “Lesson Zero” (S2E3).** A horn-and-winged filly appears in Twilight's magic-kindergarten nightmare; this fleeting animation error inspired her enduring fan name. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Kyh1hja1ts0) (scene timestamp unavailable).
- **Nightmare Night kindness — “Luna Eclipsed” (S2E4).** In an astronaut costume, she joins the costumed foals offering candy to Luna, part of the evening's happier resolution. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rOG3jlgQ0dI) (scene timestamp unavailable).
- **“Team Dash” speaks up — “Fame and Misfortune” (S7E14).** Her insistence that Rainbow Dash needs no friendship lessons illustrates how readers turn the Mane Six's journal into a divisive popularity contest. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9VD69mYisoU) (scene timestamp unavailable).
